description: 09:30 - 10:30: Pressured up control line to DHSV to 520bar. Pressured up above DHSV to 100bar w/ cement unit. DHSV did not open. Bled off pressure above DHSV. Closed LTV and retested line from cement unit to 250bar. OK. Pressured up above DHSV to 120bar, DHSV opened. Bled off pressure from the well. Rigged down cement hose and LTV
